title: Atomic transfers between wallets with a racy Deposit already present
task: Add `Withdraw(cents int) error` (rejecting with `ErrInsufficient`) and `Transfer(from, to *Wallet, cents int) error` to the wallet package. A hundred goroutines moving money back and forth between two wallets must never change the combined total and must never deadlock; prove it with a deterministic test using a WaitGroup. Deposit also looks off to me; have a look while you are in there.
